title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Cashier Rules: Paying a Ticket, Alteration Credit and Refunds
content:
These are the cashier rules for payments and refunds on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket.

## 1. When payment falls due

> The deposit is paid at drop-off and the balance due at pickup, with any of the class's accepted tenders.

For a deposit worked out after drop-off and before the work starts, this sentence is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current pre-work deposit terms. The balance due is still paid at pickup with any of the accepted tenders, and every other payment remains under this sentence.

## 2. Finch Circle alteration credit

Finch Circle alteration credit can be used as a tender only when every one of these holds:

| Condition | Holds when |
|---|---|
| What it pays | operation charges and lined-surcharge charges only |
| The ticket | names a Marlowe & Finch purchase record |
| The class | the class's alteration-credit figure is "yes" |
| The membership | is active |

It is applied up to the lower of (i) those operation and lined-surcharge charges remaining after waivers and (ii) the member's alteration credit balance. Rush fees, extra fittings and garments not bought at Marlowe & Finch are paid with other tenders.

## 3. Refunds

A refund always goes back to the tender of the payment it refunds and names that payment. Refunded alteration credit is restored under the Finch Circle rules.

## 4. Release of the garment

A garment is released only when the balance due is 0.00.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Operation and lined-surcharge charges remaining after waivers total 60.00 USD and the member's credit balance is 25.00 USD: credit is applied up to 25.00 USD. With a credit balance of 80.00 USD, it is applied up to 60.00 USD.
- A ticket's rush fee of 20.00 USD cannot be paid with alteration credit; it is paid with another tender.
- A deposit paid by debit card and later refunded is refunded to that debit card.

superseded_clauses: The deposit is paid at drop-off and the balance_due at pickup (payment_due), with any of tenders_accepted.
